professionalSummary.text: Built and maintained the dock-schedule board and shift planner in the warehouse scheduling web application using Vue.js.
professionalSummary.witness: Built and looked after the dock-schedule board and shift planner in the warehouse scheduling app (Vue): the drag-and-drop slot editor, the overlap highlighting for shifts and the printable day view planners asked for.

professionalSummary.text: Maintained the Vitest component test suite and Playwright browser test suite, including adding a board-render smoke test that must pass before releases.
professionalSummary.witness: Looked after the Vitest component tests and the Playwright browser tests; a board-render smoke test I added now has to pass before a release can go out.

professionalSummary.text: Reduced the schedule board's client-side error rate from 4.1 errors per thousand sessions to 0.9 over two months, measured against the published baseline.
professionalSummary.witness: The schedule board's client-side error rate fell from 4.1 errors per thousand sessions to 0.9 after the state-management rewrite, measured by the application's error monitoring over the following two months against the published baseline of 4.1.

professionalSummary.text: Coordinated API changes with the backend team, adapting the board and planner to approved endpoints.
professionalSummary.witness: Took API changes through the backend team's review, where the backend lead had the final say on endpoints; my side was adapting the board and planner to whatever was approved.

professionalSummary.text: Documented release limitations and maintained the frontend on-call hand-over sheet.
professionalSummary.witness: Kept the app's release write-ups, which recorded among other things that the slot editor could not yet handle multi-day slots, and the hand-over sheet the frontend on-call engineer reads.
